title: The Midnight Sigil
author: Sable Ishikawa
blurb: Gideon Winterbourne, a debt-bound temple scribe, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
